Top right: Holidays and Observances

DATA: 
The image displays a 12-month calendar for the year 2019 with various dates highlighted in different colors to represent different types of holidays and observances (secular, Christian, Jewish, Muslim, Hindu, Asian cultural).

KEY FACTS:
- Displays a full 12-month calendar for the year 2019.
- Lists numerous secular, federal, and religious holidays spanning Christianity, Judaism, Islam, Hinduism, and other observances.
- Demonstrates the high frequency of holidays and observances throughout the year that employers must navigate regarding time-off policies.
- Highlights overlapping holiday seasons, such as multiple spring holidays in April and May, and winter holidays in late December.
